```python
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Description': ['Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps'],
    '1939/40': [None], '1940/41': [42000], '1941/42': [71000],
    '1942/43': [142000], '1943/44': [218000], '1944/45': [None]
}
row = pd.DataFrame(data).set_index('Description')
years = [c for c in row.columns if row.loc['Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps', c] == row.loc['Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps'].max()]
answer = years[0]
print(answer)
```

**Answer: 1943/44** — with 218,000 deaths recorded outside of prisons & camps, the highest of any year.
